tips: | Keep your distance and aim to poke.
| Keep your distance and aim to poke.
| Just keep in mind which guns he has. Fight him when he has any combination with blue or green, but all his other guns can be very dangerous. More so if they're in combination with each other.
| Matching poke early, and she can actually disrupt your ult if no one can body block her arrow for you. But in team fights, you can most likely just E-R her and she'll die since she has no mobility.
| Pretty easy laning phase, biggest part is he can ult your ult channel, so thats pretty annoying and match your roaming movement speed.
| Keep your distance and aim to poke.

| For lane, he won't be much of a threat, but he will be exceptionally annoying to deal with during team fights since he can block your ultimate with his Shield, or even interrupt it at range with his own ult.
| Poke her down. See if you can wait until she uses her Net (E), then you can E-R her.
| Shouln't be too bad. But if you get hit by E, you might be in trouble. Keep your W ready to be used
| He can't really do much to you. Just poke him out. And if his E is ever on cooldown, then you can E-R him.
| If you have your bonus movement speed from W up, its going to be a lot easier to dodge her tornado.
| Shouldn't be too much of a problem. Once he has galeforce, it may be harder to find windows to E-R him.
| She can't do much do you. Poke her down.
| When she has ult and lands her W on you to fly across the screen, might be a few issues. Otherwise laning should be a breeze.
| Just be wary of her Q into a minion that has a spear in it to pass a E stack onto you, if she can get multiple E's off on you, you're toast. Otherwise, your E ruins her day.
| She can get pretty troubling. Her biggest windows to get you will be when your E is on cooldown and she starts running at you. Keep your distance and you should be ok.
| He can't do much to you. Poke him down.
| Keep at a very very good distance. Might need Edge of Night for the spellshield to be able to ult reliably, since she'll just drop her ult on you.
| Can get pretty dangerous if he gets into auto attack range while still having his dash up. But outside of laning phase, he shouldn't be too problematic.
| Shes really bad against poke. Poke her.
| Getting binded probably means you'll die. And her poke is kind of hard to get around too.
| Since you have a lot of bonus movement speed, you can essentially outrun his saplings for free, which reduces a lot of his threat.
| You'll probably die if you get binded. If she W's you, make sure to step off her puddle first THEN you can W, so you can dodge her possible follow-up binding.

| She'll be able to sustain through a lot of your poke early, but once laning phase ends, your E-R combo will completely shred her since her ult will take a while to get to you if she tries to inturrupt you.
| Very hard to deal with. Stay at range.
| Poke doesn't nothing to him and he can get around your combo very easily. Matching his map movements would also be really hard.
| He can be played around but too much mobility for you to make use of what you want to achieve. (Big E-R damage)
| She can't really engage and her ult will take a long time to get to you. Just poke away.
| If you get hit by 1 of her CC's, you're getting hit by all of it. Keep a good distance and poke.
| If she ever gets into dash range of you, you're in a ton of trouble. But if she screws it up, then she can't do anything to you.
| E-R combo. She can't really escape.
| She can match your range and interrupt your ult pretty easily. Might have to run around the map against her.
| She can mitigate some of your poke, but E-R combo fodder after that.
| If she's landing Q's, she's going to win the lane. Also being in range of her silence when you want to ult will be tough. Wait for her to use it first in fights.
| Don't get into flay range. You're toast if you do. Also keep in mind if he can lantern someone away from your E-R combo.
| If she has an aggressive support, she will be impossible to deal with.

| Poke him down. If he's using his stun in your direction and he's no where close to you, hes probably going to try and flash stun you. THEN you're in trouble. But if you respect that play, he can't do anything.
| Poke him down, E-R cannon fodder. But once he starts looking for flanks in team fights he'll be harder to deal with.
| E-R cannon fodder. But if he starts the fight on you first with his R, you're in trouble. Try to get the jump on him first.
| If she's playing it properly, she can get around your game plan pretty easily. But laning phase should be a breeze.
| She can't do much to you. E-R combo fodder.
| Its a game of dodge the geometry. If he can't get a lead, you'll have the advantage.
| He generally can't reach you, except for his cage. Likely, whoever uses their abilities first will come out on top.
| Poke her down. E-R combo fodder.
| Dodge his abilities and you win the lane. Going even in lane is also really good since you'll have more utility than he will.
| This will greatly depend on her lane partner, but even outside of lane, you can't do much to her either.
| It'll be hard dealing with her, and it'll only get harder as the game goes on. Early levels you can poke her, but after that, she's a problem.
| Hard to match his poke, and he can inturrupt you, OR drop his ult right on your head while you ult.
| You'll have an easy laning phase but after that, he's a problem.
| If she ults you before you ult, then you'll lose. If you can E-R her before she ults you, you'll come out on top.
| Ultimate Synergy!
| Really situational ultimate synergy. He needs purple gun with his ult, then you can do some nasty things.
